Title: General availability: Retryable writes in Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB

Body.Content:
Retryable writes in Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB enables MongoDB drivers to automatically retry certain write operations in case of failure, providing you with more flexibility when developing your applications. This ease-of-use feature can help reduce the amount of retry logic that’s necessary in your applications and speed up the development process. This feature can be enabled programmatically or via the Azure Portal.

Learn More.
